title: fynkel.Skin
description: Makes the entity's `MeshRenderer` a skinned draw (M3-19): the mesh's vertices carry joint weights into `skin` (an imported glTF `skin/<s>`), whose joints are resolved by name to entities under the one named `skeleton` — searched from the mesh entity's tree root, the root itself when `skeleton` is empty. Every frame the renderer gets one matrix per joint from those entities' (interpolated) world matrices; a joint that does not resolve stays in its bind pose. The importer writes this next to the renderer of every skinned node; the world must know the skin (`World::register_skin`; loaders do, `SKIN_UNAVAILABLE` once otherwise).

skeleton.description: Name of the skeleton root entity; empty for the tree root.
